title: Winged zebrafish - 3D-printable anatomical puzzle kit
stage: 1 of 2 (whole animal + glider shipped; assembly kit in progress)
hypothetical_note: HYPOTHETICAL: this piece belongs to the design 'winged zebrafish - zebrafish with the pectoral fin proportion moved toward the flying fish', not to any described animal. It was generated from a parameter set, not observed.

source_mesh.units_and_axes: glTF Y-up; head at +X, back at +Y, the fish's left side at -Z. The adult / resolved set has SL = 0.82 model units; earlier growth stages are built at their TRUE relative size SL(age)/SL(adult), so development plays as real growth. standard_length_m = 0.0388 m sets the metres per model unit.

whole_animal_and_glider.why: a display size that fits one 200x200 mm plate with the fins spread

physical_measurements_whole_animal.note: measured on the exported mesh, not estimated

pectoral_lifting_area.note: projected planform of the two pectoral fin membranes (single-layer source sheets, not the thickened print geometry), projected onto the horizontal span-chord plane; each object's own world transform preserved.

parts.kind: stage 1 - whole animal, one piece, solid
parts.label: winged zebrafish, whole animal

deviations.reason: the source skin is a surface with no thickness; a surface cannot be printed
minimum printable wall at this scale; the real membrane is far thinner, so the printed fins are thicker than the design implies

deviations.change: voxel remesh to union the overlapping parts into one closed solid
deviations.reason: guarantees watertightness; rounds detail finer than 0.45 mm

parts.hypothetical_note: HYPOTHETICAL: this piece belongs to the design 'winged zebrafish - zebrafish with the pectoral fin proportion moved toward the flying fish', not to any described animal. It was generated from a parameter set, not observed.

parts.kind: one-piece GLIDER variant - NOT part of the teaching kit
parts.label: winged zebrafish, one-piece glider
parts.hollow_region: body only; fins and fin rays printed solid
parts.no_joinery: no sockets, no pegs, no index marks - this part is one solid shell

deviations.change: fin membrane solidified thicker than the kit, for strength in flight
deviations.reason: a 1.0 mm fin snaps on landing; 1.8 mm is a deliberate departure from the design's fin proportion in the thickness direction only - span, chord and planform area are unchanged

deviations.change: body hollowed by an inward-offset inner shell
deviations.reason: reduces mass from 44 g to 18 g in PLA

parts.sealed_cavity_warning: the cavity is sealed; for resin printing add a drain hole. For FDM slice with 0 infill and this wall.
parts.glide_performance: UNVERIFIED. See README. No wind-tunnel or free-flight test has been run on this geometry and its stability has not been checked.
parts.hypothetical_note: HYPOTHETICAL: this piece belongs to the design 'winged zebrafish - zebrafish with the pectoral fin proportion moved toward the flying fish', not to any described animal. It was generated from a parameter set, not observed.

verification.method: Blender 4.2.23 bmesh: every edge must have exactly 2 faces (watertight), every edge must be contiguous i.e. its two faces wound oppositely (no inverted normals, concavity-proof), no loose verts or edges, and signed volume > 0 (the consistent orientation points outward).
